Founded in Bologna in 1907
ORSI is one of the few significant Italian companies in the domestic and institutional powder detergent market
Competing in experience, technology, and quality with the leading companies in the sector.
Today, ORSI invests in Research and Development to innovate in the field of detergency and cosmetics.

ourHistoryText1: Founded in Bologna in 1907, ORSI has gone through more than a century of Italian history, continuously evolving its products to meet the needs of a constantly changing market. From the first soap formulations to modern eco-sustainable solutions, our commitment to quality and innovation has remained unchanged.
ourHistoryText2: Each ORSI brand represents this evolution, combining the tradition of our experience with the innovation of the most modern technologies, to offer effective, safe and environmentally friendly products.
certificationsPageSubtitle: Our certifications demonstrate our commitment to quality, sustainability, and responsible innovation. We constantly work to maintain and improve the highest standards in all our processes.
bureauVeritasDescriptionCertPage: Bureau Veritas certification guarantees that our processes and products meet international quality standards. This recognition testifies to our commitment to producing detergents that respect human health and the environment.
organicCertificationDescriptionCertPage: Our organic products are certified according to European standards to ensure the use of natural ingredients and sustainable production processes, respecting the environment and biodiversity.
ourCommitmentToQualityText: At Orsi S.R.L., quality and sustainability are at the heart of our business model. The certifications we have obtained are not just documents, but represent our corporate philosophy and our daily commitment to customers and the environment.
qualityManagementSystemText: We apply rigorous controls at every stage of production to ensure products of excellence.
environmentalSustainabilityText: We use production processes with low environmental impact and work to constantly reduce our ecological footprint.
continuousInnovationText: We invest in research and development to constantly improve the formulas of our products, making them more effective and sustainable.
transparencyText: We communicate clearly and completely the composition of our products, because we believe that consumers have the right to accurate information.
ourQualityPolicyText: We are committed to developing, producing, and distributing innovative detergents that meet the needs of our customers, always respecting the environment and contributing to a more sustainable future. Our company, founded in Bologna in 1907, continues to evolve while maintaining the principles of excellence and responsibility that have always distinguished us.
contactPageSubtitle: We are here to answer any questions about our products and services. Do not hesitate to contact us for more information.
